description: Outside Agent turns a plain-language brief into a hosted AI agent you can publish to SMS, voice, and web without leaving your coding agent. Describe what the agent should do and it composes the full configuration, grounds it in your own content, runs a safety review, and ships it. Create agents, seed a knowledge base, preview replies before publishing, issue a phone number, and manage everything you’ve built, all through natural conversation.

defaultPrompt: Build me a customer-support agent for my business and publish it
Publish my agent to SMS and give it a phone number
